title: AcademiQ Student Data Import Contract
description: Field contract for the three normalized CSV tables produced from the source Student_Master_Data.xlsx. Antigravity should validate every row against this before writing to academic-data-service.

source_provenance.extraction_date_note: Generated by a one-off transform script; re-run the transform if the source file is updated rather than hand-editing the CSVs.
known_gaps: No Semester End Exam (SEE) marks present anywhere in the source.
No quiz1/quiz2 scores — this institution's CIE scheme uses tests + one assignment, not quizzes.
No credits, gender, email, phone, admission_quota, mentor_faculty_id, academic_term, enrollment_status.
No parent_contacts, placement_records, student_achievements, or SGPA/CGPA/risk data of any kind.

department_id.notes: Derived from the 'CS' branch code embedded in every USN. Confirm this matches the actual department_id key used in your departments table.

semester.derivation: Max semester seen across this student's course records in the source file. NOT a live current-semester value — treat as a hint only.

academic_term.notes: Source file carries no academic-year/term tag at all.

student_name.notes: Carried for QA/cross-check only; not part of the canonical schema. Drop before writing to the courses_data JSON matrix if your API rejects unknown fields.

quiz1.notes: This institution's IA scheme has no quiz component for these courses.

el.source_column: ASN1 (only present for the 2-test + assignment courses: CS3C03)

cie_reduced.notes: AUTHORITATIVE value as computed and reported by the institution (best-2-of-3 tests, or 2 tests + assignment). Trust this over cie_raw_equiv_100.

cie_raw_equiv_100.warning: SYNTHETIC. Does not use the AcademiQ spec's stated formula (cie1+cie2+quiz1+quiz2+el summed to 100) because this institution's real IA scheme differs (best-2-of-3 tests). Only exists to fill the schema's cie_raw slot. Antigravity should confirm with the project owner whether this field should be written to the DB at all, or left null so the real formula can be recomputed once quiz/credit data is confirmed.

see_raw.source: Separate Semester End Exam mark sheet (not yet supplied)

course_status.notes: Everything is 'in_progress' because no SEE score exists yet to determine pass/fail.

assessment_notes.notes: Semicolon-joined flags recovered from 'A' and 'NE' cells in the source.

attendance_pct.cross_checked: Verified against classes_attended/classes_conducted*100 for all rows at build time; 0 mismatches found.

validation_rules: Every student_id in Course_Assessments and Attendance MUST exist in Students.student_id (referential integrity).
No duplicate (student_id, course_code, semester, section) rows are permitted within Course_Assessments or within Attendance.
cie1/cie2/cie3 must fall within their course's actual max test mark (25 for CS3C01/CS6C04/CS8E501; 20 for CS3C03) — see course_mark_scales below.
attendance_pct must be between 0 and 100 inclusive.

CS3C01.cie_formula: sum of best 2 of 3 tests, out of 50

CS6C04.cie_formula: sum of best 2 of 3 tests, out of 50

CS8E501.cie_formula: sum of best 2 of 3 tests, out of 50
